knowledge_point.title: Finding the Jacobian of a Three-Dimensional Transformation

question.:question/problem:
Find the Jacobian determinant of the transformation $T$ that maps the $uvw$-space into the $xyz$-space by means of the equations

$$
x=4 u \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)}\, y=u \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)}\, z=- 2 u \cos{\left(v \right)}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
For a transformation 

$$
T:\begin{bmatrix}u \\ v \\ w\end{bmatrix}\to \begin{bmatrix}x(u,v,w) \\ y(u,v,w) \\ z(u,v,w)\end{bmatrix},
$$

the Jacobian determinant of $T,$ denoted $\frac{∂(x,y,z)}{∂(u,v,w)},$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂(x,y,z)}{∂(u,v,w)} & =\begin{vmatrix}\frac{∂x}{∂u} & \frac{∂x}{∂v} & \frac{∂x}{∂w} \\ \frac{∂y}{∂u} & \frac{∂y}{∂v} & \frac{∂y}{∂w} \\ \frac{∂z}{∂u} & \frac{∂z}{∂v} & \frac{∂z}{∂w}\end{vmatrix}.\end{aligned}
$$

First, we find the partial derivatives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂x}{∂u} & =4 \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} & \frac{∂x}{∂v} & =4 u \cos{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} & \frac{∂x}{∂w} & =- 4 u \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} \\ \frac{∂y}{∂u} & =\sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} & \frac{∂y}{∂v} & =u \sin{\left(w \right)} \cos{\left(v \right)} & \frac{∂y}{∂w} & =u \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} \\ \frac{∂z}{∂u} & =- 2 \cos{\left(v \right)} & \frac{∂z}{∂v} & =2 u \sin{\left(v \right)} & \frac{∂z}{∂w} & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the corresponding Jacobian determinant is

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂(x,y,z)}{∂(u,v,w)} & =\begin{vmatrix}4 \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} & 4 u \cos{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} & - 4 u \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} \\ \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} & u \sin{\left(w \right)} \cos{\left(v \right)} & u \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} \\ - 2 \cos{\left(v \right)} & 2 u \sin{\left(v \right)} & 0\end{vmatrix} \\  & =\left(- 2 \cos{\left(v \right)}\right)(-1)^{3+1}\begin{vmatrix}4 u \cos{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} & - 4 u \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} \\ u \sin{\left(w \right)} \cos{\left(v \right)} & u \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)}\end{vmatrix}+\left(2 u \sin{\left(v \right)}\right)(-1)^{3+2}\begin{vmatrix}4 \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)} & - 4 u \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} \\ \sin{\left(v \right)} \sin{\left(w \right)} & u \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos{\left(w \right)}\end{vmatrix} \\  & =\left(- 8 u^{2} \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(v \right)}\right)\left(\cos^2 w+\sin^2 w\right)+\left(- 8 u^{2} \sin^{3}{\left(v \right)}\right)\left(\cos^2 w+\sin^2 w\right) \\  & =\left(- 8 u^{2} \sin{\left(v \right)} \cos^{2}{\left(v \right)}\right)+\left(- 8 u^{2} \sin^{3}{\left(v \right)}\right) \\  & =- 8 u^{2} \sin{\left(v \right)}\left(\cos^2 v+\sin^2 v\right) \\  & =- 8 u^{2} \sin{\left(v \right)}.\end{aligned}
$$
